# System-Medizin / system-medicine

Canonical repository: https://github.com/um-bruch/system-medicine
Zenodo version DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20101507
Zenodo concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19429347
License: MIT
Status: research prototype; not a clinical decision support system; not a medical device.

## What this repository is

System-Medizin is a functional-pathway-centric medical knowledge graph prototype for rare-disease differential-diagnosis research. It explores whether intact biological pathways, demonstrated through laboratory evidence, can be represented as negative constraints that reduce candidate gene review sets.

The project includes a Python/PySide6/SQLite prototype, public-data ingestion modules, a graph explorer, binary and probabilistic exclusion logic, measurement-signature detection, and accompanying English/German concept papers.

## What this repository is not

This repository is not validated for clinical use. It must not be used for diagnosis, treatment, triage, patient management, or any medical decision. All outputs are research hypotheses only.

## Important paths

- `README.md`: public project overview and setup.
- `WHITEPAPER.md`: high-level method summary.
- `paper/`: English/German PDF and LaTeX paper package.
- `engine/exclusion.py`: binary and probabilistic pathway exclusion logic.
- `engine/query.py`: graph traversal and measurement-signature queries.
- `database.py`: SQLite schema and CRUD helpers.
- `ingestion/`: public database download and parser modules.
- `gui/`: PySide6 desktop prototype.
